prompt_used: You are given an image. Write a detailed natural language prompt that could have been used to generate this image. Focus on the most salient and unique visual elements such as the subjects, their clothing, expressions, actions, background, and composition. Describe the color palette, lighting, and overall style, including any cinematic or artistic qualities like camera angle, depth of field, or motion. Make the description as accurate and faithful to the image as possible. If small details are uncertain or ambiguous, omit them and prioritize capturing the overall scene, mood, and visual impression. The final prompt should be coherent, evocative, written as if by an expert visual artist or filmmaker recreating the exact scene.
caption: Create a dramatic, cinematic book cover illustration that blends the world of Harry Potter with the post-apocalyptic aesthetic of Fallout: New Vegas. The scene features four main characters standing in the foreground, all dressed in rugged, armored outfits reminiscent of wasteland survivors. The central figure is a young man with round glasses and a lightning-shaped scar, holding a wand in one hand and a futuristic rifle in the other. To his right stands a young woman with wavy brown hair, also armed and wearing tactical gear, exuding determination. On his left is a red-haired young man, similarly equipped, looking slightly anxious but resolute. Behind them looms a towering, bearded man in heavy armor, evoking a protective presence, and to the side, a small, goblin-like creature in scavenged armor clutches a weapon. In the misty, green-tinted background, a dilapidated sign reads "Welcome to Hogwarts," and a menacing, armored witch rides a broomstick through the smoky sky. The overall color palette is muted and earthy, dominated by olive greens and browns, with a moody, overcast atmosphere. The lighting is diffuse and somber, enhancing the sense of danger and adventure. The composition is heroic and slightly symmetrical, with a painterly, detailed style that combines fantasy and dystopian sci-fi elements. The title "Harry Potter: New Vegas" is boldly displayed at the top in stylized, golden letters, with the author’s name, "J.K. Bethesda," at the bottom, completing the fusion of iconic fantasy and video game motifs.
